condition: Maintained instrument-family approximations, not verified hardware emulations.
architecture: A/B -> Filter 1 -> Main serial FX -> output. Unused sources/Filter 2 disabled; no auxiliary buses or direct paths.

five_analog_techniques.voice_calibration: Not used: native control scales uncalibrated; stable source architecture chosen.
five_analog_techniques.noise_FM: Off: not needed for clean maintained character.
five_analog_techniques.continuous_drift: Off: DCO stays stable; VCO layers use documented static fine offsets. Phase randomness is not claimed as drift.
five_analog_techniques.drive_tape: Small voice-filter drive only; no tape/wow/fast compression added by default.

limitations: Juno pad uses a factory sampled PWM wavetable scan, not proof of a DCO circuit or duty-cycle emulation.
Phase memory and voice-priority controls stay at Init; unsupported phase/voice calibration behavior is not claimed.
Cutoff and modulation depths are stored normalized values, not measured Hz/cents endpoints.
Delay time is fixed at 30/124 seconds (eighth note at 124 BPM), explicitly free mode; retime after tempo changes.
Filter changes are CC1 -> mod_wheel routes; macros default to Tone 15 and Contour 20, with usable ranges requiring listening validation.
Native plugin loading, audio renders, stereo/mono response and listening are separate untested steps.
acceptance: 7 real native presets, independent readback and wire-type scan.
All wavetable dependencies resolve and hashes recorded; no custom resources.
Bass and lead mono; pad/brass polyphony budget 16; unused internal arp disabled.
MIDI note ranges and actual gates appropriate to source envelopes; voice-filter and FX intent documented.

Tone.effect: Adds 0..10 percentage points of filter modulation at the stored route scale.

Contour.effect: Lengthens timbre-envelope decay via 0..12% route; physical seconds need plugin calibration.
